title: Section 36 Arbitration Act — Enforcement - educational example

content.body: Educational example, not an official statutory illustration and not a decided case. Use only the law already recorded in this topic file. Recorded point for Section 36 Arbitration Act — Enforcement: An award is enforced as a decree under the CPC. A section 34 petition does not automatically stay execution.
